manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Yannik until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
